metadata.title: Retro Glamour Portrait with Beveled Display Type

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait featuring a subject in vibrant red attire, anchored by large-scale beveled geometric display typography at the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up portrait of a woman with short dark hair wearing a sheer red blouse, set against a clean white background with a soft red glow. The top of the frame is dominated by wide-tracked, beveled geometric capital letters with a metallic red finish.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography spans the full width of the upper margin
Subject's red blouse echoes the color of the beveled text
Soft lighting creates a halo effect around the subject against the white void
Geometric rigidity of the font contrasts with the soft organic folds of the fabric
coreInvariants: Beveled 3D effect on the display typography
High-key white background with localized red color bleed
Vibrant red as the primary thematic color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, framed from the waist up, occupying the lower two-thirds of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized display text at the top serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold text, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the vibrant red of the blouse toward the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space around the subject's head emphasizes the clean, high-key studio aesthetic.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against a high-value, low-saturation white background.

letterConstructionRules: Sharp 45-degree bevels creating a 3D metallic effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' features a detached leg that follows the angle of the bevel
The 'Y' is constructed with two diagonal strokes meeting at a low vertex
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone display type with no secondary text to maintain focus on the portrait.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide geometric skeleton and retro-tech feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus studio portrait of a person in a vibrant red silk blouse against a high-key white background with a subtle red glow reflecting off the backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, wide-tracked geometric capital letters across the top. Apply a red metallic bevel effect to the letters to give them a 3D appearance.

verificationChecks: Is the background predominantly high-key white?
Does the red of the text match the red of the clothing?
Is the tracking wide enough to span the image width?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the beveling on the letters is consistent in light direction.
Ensure the red blouse has a silk-like sheen.
Verify the text is perfectly centered and horizontally aligned.
Confirm the high-key background does not wash out the subject's skin tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + [Subject Description] + [Color Theme] + Beveled Geometric Display Type.
